map.可以，而且这是它的常见用法。因为输出只有 1–5 五个数字，很适合再做一次置换或: Yes, and that is its common use. Because the output contains only the digits 1–5, it is well suited to a second round of permutation or to serving as the first layer of ADFGVX (which is exactly how it evolved historically). Once combined it is no longer a simple substitution and becomes noticeably harder to break — an early form of the product cipher idea.
